class.name: SteamUtils
class.brief_description: Reads platform and overlay state from Steam.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.utils]. Hardware, language, and overlay queries read Steam's current client state.

method.name: hardware_default_config
method.description: Returns Steam's suggested starting preset for this game and device. Use it when choosing initial settings and let players retain their own settings. Returns [constant CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE] when Steam cannot supply the query.

method.name: hardware_type
method.description: Returns the Steam-reported hardware type. Returns [constant HARDWARE_UNAVAILABLE] when Steam cannot supply the query.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the active client exposes the Steam Utils interface on the main thread.

method.name: is_overlay_ready
method.description: Returns whether the Steam overlay is available to this process now. Check again before requesting an overlay action after startup.

method.name: is_running_in_vr
method.description: Returns whether Steam reports that the Steam client is running in VR mode. Returns [code]false[/code] when the query is unavailable.

method.name: is_running_under_proton
method.description: Returns whether Steam reports that the game process is running under Proton. Returns [code]false[/code] when the query is unavailable.

method.name: ui_language
method.description: Returns the Steam client's interface language code, or an empty string when unavailable. For the selected game language, use [method SteamApps.current_language].
